'''Bingo Card''' is a {{Special}} [[Collectable Items|Collectable]] item. It is obtained by completing every [[Bingo#Goals|Goal]] on a [[Bingo]] [[Events|Event]]'s [[Bingo#Bingo Card|Bingo Card]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Bingo ===
A '''Bingo Card''' can be claimed from {{NPCSprite|Jerry}} after completing all 20 [[Bingo#Goals|Goals]] on a [[Bingo]] [[Events|Event]]'s [[Bingo#Bingo Card|Bingo Card]].

== Usage ==
A '''Bingo Card''' shows stats about which [[Bingo]] event's [[Bingo#Bingo Card|Bingo Card]] was completed, which player completed them, and how long they took.

== Trivia ==
*The playtime indicated refers specifically to the time the player spent online on the bingo profile prior to completing the entire [[Bingo#Bingo Card|Bingo Card]], not the time since the start of the Bingo event. 
*Community goals do not affect obtaining the card, whether it be not having contributed in one or a goal not reaching its first tier.
